meta.title: Clinic Admissions Dashboard User Guide
meta.subtitle: How to find, filter, read and export admissions data
meta.audience: Facility administrators and regional operations leaders
meta.purpose: Help leaders answer their own admissions questions without ad hoc report requests
sources: Synthetic example content for the document-builder skill; replace with the request, attachments and the sources the user names

blocks.text: The admissions dashboard shows daily admissions, discharges and census for every clinic you can access. This guide explains how to open it, read each view and export the numbers you need.
All numbers in this guide are synthetic examples. Your dashboard shows only the facilities your access request covers.

items: Facility administrators who track weekly admissions
Analysts who export data for reviews
Open the dashboard and set your filters
Read the KPI ribbon and trend chart

blocks.text: Before you start, confirm your access request was approved. Approval usually takes one business day.

steps.text: Open the analytics portal from the **Tools** menu on the intranet home page.

steps.result: The dashboard opens on the Overview tab with last week's data.
steps.caption: The Overview tab after the dashboard opens
steps.alt: Admissions dashboard overview tab with filters across the top

steps.text: Bookmark the page so you can return to it in one click.

blocks.text: Filters apply to every tab. The dashboard remembers them until you select **Reset**.

blocks.caption: Filters and what they change
rows: The period every chart and number covers
One or more clinics within the region
Modality group, such as in-center or home

blocks.text: Select **Save View** to keep your filters and open the dashboard ready next time.
The ribbon shows four headline numbers for the filtered period: admissions, discharges, net change and census. Each compares with the previous period.

blocks.caption: Admissions versus discharges trend chart
blocks.alt: Line chart of daily admissions and discharges with a 30-day rolling average

blocks.text: The solid line is the 30-day rolling average. Select any point to see that day's detail.

steps.text: Set the filters you want in the report.
Select **Export** in the top-right corner, then choose **CSV** or **PDF**.
Save the file to your secure network folder.
steps.result: The file keeps the filters you applied.

blocks.text: Never send exported files by external email. Keep patient-level data on the secure network.

blocks.code:
File name pattern: Admissions_<Region>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv
Example:           Admissions_West_2026-10-05.csv

blocks.text: Look up a headline number here without reading the whole guide. Every number covers the period in your date range filter.

rows: New patients who started treatment in the period

blocks.text: For questions about the numbers, contact the Clinic Operations Analytics team mailbox. For access problems, open a ticket in the service portal.

blocks.text: "The West region census on Oct. 5 shows 412, but our clinic count shows 409. Can you check the source?"
